The grassy surface of temperate terrain. Breaking it gives [Dirt](Item-dirt.md).

## At a glance

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Stack size | 64 |
| Placement | Place from the hotbar |

## How to obtain

Find it on the surface. Mining drops dirt, so use the Creative catalog to obtain the grass block item.

## Crafting and processing

There is no registered crafting or processing recipe for this item. Use the acquisition method above.
